caption: They pressed the OFF button… and Chernobyl exploded 😳☢️ The fatal flaw hidden in the reactor's control rods. Would you have pressed it? 👇 #chernobyl #history #nuclear #historytok #documentary #dailydrop

scenes.title: They pressed *the off button.*
scenes.say: At Chernobyl, they pressed the button that was supposed to shut the reactor down. Seconds later, it exploded.

scenes.title: A test gone wrong
scenes.say: It was the middle of the night. Operators were running a delayed safety test, and the reactor's power had collapsed to almost nothing.

scenes.title: To get power back, they *broke the rules*
scenes.say: To bring it back, they pulled control rods out of the core. The rules said at least fifteen had to stay in. They were down to about eight.
When the power started to climb, someone pressed A Z five, the emergency shutdown button. Every control rod began driving back in.
scenes.display: When the power started to climb, someone pressed AZ-5, the emergency shutdown button. Every control rod began driving back in.

scenes.title: But the rods had *graphite tips*
scenes.say: But those rods had a fatal flaw. Their tips were made of graphite, which speeds the reaction up. The tips went in first. And instead of dropping, the power surged.

scenes.title: Seconds later:
scenes.say: Within seconds, Reactor Number Four exploded. The button meant to stop the disaster set it off.
So, would you have pressed it? The full story is on our channel.
